name: To The Hinterlands
summary: High Thane Falstad Wildhammer at Aerie Peak wants to speak with you. Trolls are causing trouble in the Hinterlands, and he has little time to spare.

sections.title: At Aerie Peak
sections.body: Falstad Wildhammer has matters pressing at Aerie Peak. When you speak with the High Thane, he says trolls are appearing throughout the Hinterlands. He has little patience for delay while the trouble grows.

faq.q: Who should I speak with in the Hinterlands?
faq.answer: Speak with High Thane Falstad Wildhammer at Aerie Peak in the Hinterlands.
Falstad says trolls are appearing throughout the Hinterlands.
High Thane Falstad Wildhammer is at Aerie Peak in the Hinterlands.
